question: What is the meaning of dismantling and disassembly guidelines in relation to technical reports (manufacturer provided)?
description: Dismantling guidelines focus on the ability to take a product apart in a way that allows some parts to be reused or recycled, particularly for end-of-life products. On the other hand, disassembly guidelines emphasize the non-destructive process of breaking down a product into its relevant parts, enabling subsequent reassembly for repair, upgrade, remanufacture, or part reuse.
